name: Tokens
title: Templates/Platform/Account/Tokens
summary: The Personal tokens page of the account settings: a `PageHeader` with Documentation and Create Personal Token, a search `Input` and Refresh over a `Table` of tokens (name with its description, `Table.CellStatus` for Active, Expires in N days, Expired or Revoked, the expiry date, `Table.CellTime` for last use and creation, `Table.CellActions` with Revoke or Delete), all on one `useCollection`. Create opens a `Drawer` (name, description, expiry `Select` that states the date), and the new secret appears once in a `Dialog` with a warning `Alert`, a read-only `PasswordInput` and a `CopyButton`. Revoke and Delete go through `ConfirmDialog`, and their outcome is a toast. A page body for ConsoleLayout, rendered in its default slot.

variants.name: Empty
variants.summary: No token yet: the heading stays and a flush card with an EmptyState and Create Personal Token replaces the search row and the table.

variants.name: Loading
variants.summary: The first load: the search row and the table shell with its loading rows, before the empty state can be decided.

variants.name: Failed
variants.summary: The list could not load: a danger Alert with Retry in place of the table; Retry loads the tokens.

variants.name: Created
variants.summary: Right after Create: the one-time reveal Dialog with the warning, the masked secret with show and copy, and a confirmation that the token was copied.
